g.title: KayaRank1Convo3 begins.
g.text: KayaRank1Convo3 begins.

g.title: j3384929246
g.text: Time travel - is it expensive? A cost associated in raw materials? Or has it been commodified in your time in a way that is relevant to anything here?

g.title: j1039846313
g.text: Why? Looking to save up a few höllars and bribe me?

g.title: j4137259857
g.text: Some costs don’t have höllar signs. And hi, by the way.

g.title: j2781212404
g.text: It worked on Entrati.

g.title: j1251123069
g.text: Hi. So it's not like I can just pay someone something and just learn how to do it?

g.title: j1161709235
g.text: Pardon me?

g.title: j3619064459
g.text: What?

g.title: j3180771366
g.text: You know that your batch 'Nova' has nothing to do with Time Travel right?

g.title: j2903840975
g.text: Listen, you really seem to only care about one thing. Time travel. Why?

g.title: j2375698720
g.text: You can't. [End].

g.title: j1310704431
g.text: Check boolean KayaSetFound

g.title: j3091024476
g.text: What Nova can and can't do doesn't matter.

g.title: j3955314637
g.text: You wouldn't get it.

g.title: j3994434447
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j670128772
g.text: Duh, I told you already. I found him.

g.title: j1310704431->j670128772
g.text: true

g.title: j3347092066
g.text: And get this.

g.title: j1310704431->j3347092066
g.text: false

g.title: j2647674648
g.text: Check boolean KayaAmirTravel

g.title: j3876803453
g.text: You don't know me. Or wait, that's your line?

g.title: j3643079289
g.text: I can promise you I would.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo1.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo1.

g.title: j3994434447->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo1.
j3862297121
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1673650077
g.text: So he's on his computer or whatever.

g.title: j3700671942
g.text: Well, we're trying to make the most of our tools I guess. Did you talk to Amir about your questions?

g.title: j2647674648->j3700671942
g.text: true

g.title: j368315635
g.text: Check boolean KayaLettieHeal

g.title: j2647674648->j368315635
g.text: false

g.title: j3876170803
g.text: Yeah, I don't know you. I just know what you can do. Which is why we're talking. Like, be serious.

g.title: j537634424
g.text: A promise from a stranger on the internet. Give me a break. Ha. Just tell me what I want to know.

g.title: j3044227435
g.text: And I show up, and he actually gets scared. Like, he did NOT even expect someone to show up.

g.title: j1907090275
g.text: I did. We agree on some fundamentals but he doesn't seem interested in a concrete and reproducible time travel theorem.

g.title: j3157189933
g.text: Well, we're trying to make the most of our tools I guess. Did you talk to Lettie? I feel like you and her would get along.

g.title: j368315635->j3157189933
g.text: true

g.title: j3944524196
g.text: Right, just meant it would be a bit easier I guess if you could access more tools from my time..

g.title: j368315635->j3944524196
g.text: false

g.title: j988946811
g.text: Ok, let's be serious.

g.title: j2436786705
g.text: Did something happen to you?

g.title: j2777631197
g.text: Wow, that's impressive.

g.title: j3345679033
g.text: Wow are you actually bragging?

g.title: j1620038761
g.text: In fact, he's convinced me that I was wrong in some of my original hypothesis so it did help, but he reminded me that maybe I can just pay my way to an answer, or at least pay to talk to someone else from the future if you don't help me.

g.title: j163100643
g.text: We do get along. She reminds me of a teacher I had once, 0 nastiness and saw me for my brain.

g.title: j3133187938
g.text: Is that an offer? What can I access? Anything would help.

g.title: j4285909497
g.text: You want to time travel, but where? Why?

g.title: j1481813136
g.text: Have you looked around?

g.title: j3483190430
g.text: Something happened to all of us. Just let me know if you figure out a way to help me out.

g.title: j2970037045
g.text: Ugh, why am I telling you this again?

g.title: j3732042773
g.text: For 10 höllars I'll tell you how you die.

g.title: j2435421397
g.text: Anyone who's selling you something like that is lying. I will try and help you, I really will. No charge.

g.title: j1092399836
g.text: She's actually really like super chill. Smart too. Although, she told me to trust you for real so, I guess we'll see.

g.title: j1175708151
g.text: I'll see what I can find for you, if you want to figure it out on your terms.

g.title: j3757105305
g.text: Can you figure ANYTHING out? Ugh.

g.title: j2792329471
g.text: Yeah, I have. I've seen it all. This miraculous turn of the millennium. Invites to sooo many parties cause people wanted 'that girl' there.

g.title: j955058429
g.text: Just tell me, do I need to save up or anything?

g.title: j3815520537
g.text: Ugh. Sicko.

g.title: j720822102
g.text: We'll see, won't we.

g.title: j3270022666
g.text: I'm not here to betray you or anything, and I'm not a time travel textbook

g.title: j2143780103
g.text: I promise you that you can trust me, I'm not sure why you're so hostile.

g.title: j1502172742
g.text: I do. I will.

g.title: j2894643569
g.text: Who would even want to stay here? Like..

g.title: j4202767775
g.text: It's never going to stop. Look forward. Find me when you can help.

g.title: j3357394592
g.text: Kaya I think you're a little too hyperfixated on this. What if you can't figure it out?

g.title: j233681568
g.text: No idea. I'm the choseeennnn one, Kaya.

g.title: j41162033
g.text: Ugh. K

g.title: j1542338451
g.text: I have my reasons

g.title: j3481460055
g.text: I'll figure it out, I know I can so, yeah. Bye.

g.title: j1602477871
g.text: I will.

g.title: j1506808990
g.text: Yah a total chosen DICKHEAD
